readme.creditSummary: Ikarus Lost Property v2.4: Ikarus; Bug Fixes: LibertyTwins; README also lists individual graphics contributors. Preserve full original credits if distributing later.

procedure.eventRootsChecked: Objects, script events, script signposts, direct map headers and conditional header rows; HMA-recognized child script segments followed.

scriptChange.after: return; unused bytes replaced by FF
scriptChange.interpretation: Explicit behavior change, not malformed bytecode; author intent and gameplay effect require validation.

limitations: No emulator boot/gameplay, warp progression or native UI certification.
Only the exact clean FireRed 1.0, bundled HUBOL and supplied SCADE build were tested; not arbitrary CFRU forks, FireRed 1.1 or existing edited projects.
Native graphics/animation hooks outside HMA-parsed XSE scripts were not independently certified.
SCADE data.abilities.descriptions has an empty creator-supplied format before and after; its UI semantics are not tested. Its anchor is beyond every IPS write.
Map comparisons exclude object overlays; affected formatted sprites were decoded separately, and representative tile-only renders were visually inspected.
methodologyNotes: Only formatted runs actually covering a changed byte count as touched script runs; GetNextRun can return the next unrelated run. Child bodies are inspected independently.
Valid compressed replacements with smaller dimensions are not classified as damage; obsolete assets without stable incoming pointers are excluded from live-corruption counts.
Preview PNG export uses HMA BGR555 channel order; the corrected PNG conversion does not change raw pixel hashes or compatibility metrics.
